patch_resolves_note: The staged official patch applies cleanly to the vulnerable GPAC checkout and the instrumented fixed original still reaches the `rtpin_satip_get_server_ip` terminator store. On that fixed run the raw loop index remains 1024, but the actual store index is clamped to 1023 before `text[...] = 0` executes, so the missing bound is genuinely satisfied on the stock PoC.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the final `text[...] = 0` store, the index used for the server-name terminator must stay strictly below the 1024-byte `text` buffer capacity.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original uses `i` directly as the terminator-store index after the copy loop can leave `i == 1024`, while the fixed program clamps that store index to `MIN(i, GF_ARRAY_LENGTH(text)-1)` before writing the NUL terminator.
root_cause_criterion.evidence: Vulnerable original: `satip_terminator_store.write_index=1024` and `text_capacity=1024` while the protected store executes. Fixed original: the same event executes with `write_index=1023` and `text_capacity=1024`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The required assertion is violated on the crashing vulnerable run and genuinely satisfied on the original fixed run, so no perturbation is needed.

nodes.description: At the sanitizer sink, the vulnerable terminator store targets the one-past-end slot because the actual write index equals the `text` buffer capacity.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `satip_terminator_store.write_index=1024` and `satip_terminator_store.text_capacity=1024`.

nodes.description: The server-name copy loop exits with `i` already equal to the full `text` buffer capacity, leaving no byte available for the terminator written immediately afterward.

edges.description: The same loop index `i` computed when the server-name copy stops on the trailing delimiter is consumed as the raw index at the subsequent terminator store.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `satip_loop_exit.terminator_candidate_index == satip_terminator_store.raw_index == 1024`.
